items.sentence: She ___ to school every day.
items.explanation: В Present Simple для третьего лица единственного числа используется окончание -s.

items.sentence: They ___ the movie last night.
items.explanation: Past Simple регулярного глагола добавляет -ed.

items.sentence: I ___ my homework already.
items.explanation: Present Perfect используется с already.

items.sentence: We ___ to the park tomorrow.
items.explanation: Для будущего действия используется will + инфинитив.

items.sentence: He ___ play the piano very well.
items.explanation: Модальный глагол can не меняется по лицам.

items.sentence: If it rains, we ___ stay at home.
items.explanation: В первом типе условных предложений после if present simple, в главной — will.

items.sentence: She ___ been waiting for an hour.
items.explanation: Present Perfect Continuous: has + been + V-ing.

items.sentence: The book ___ on the table.
items.explanation: Глагол lie (лежать) в Present Simple для 3-го лица — lies.

items.sentence: They ___ not like spicy food.
items.explanation: В отрицании Present Simple используется вспомогательный do для I/you/we/they.

items.sentence: My brother ___ a new car last month.
items.explanation: Past Simple неправильного глагола buy — bought.

items.sentence: We ___ never been to Japan.
items.explanation: Present Perfect с never: have + past participle.

items.sentence: She ___ to music while studying.
items.explanation: Present Simple 3-е лицо единственного числа — добавляется -s.

items.sentence: The train ___ at 6 p.m. every day.
items.explanation: Расписание — Present Simple, 3-е лицо — arrives.

items.sentence: I ___ you a message yesterday.
items.explanation: Past Simple неправильного глагола send — sent.

items.sentence: They ___ going to the cinema tonight.
items.explanation: Present Continuous: are + V-ing для they.

items.sentence: He ___ his keys somewhere.
items.explanation: Past Simple неправильного глагола lose — lost.

items.sentence: We ___ finish the project by Friday.
items.explanation: Future Perfect: will have + past participle.

items.sentence: She ___ not understand the question.
items.explanation: Отрицание Present Simple для 3-го лица — does not.

items.sentence: If I ___ you, I would call her.
items.explanation: Второго типа условное: if + Past Simple (were для всех лиц).

items.sentence: The children ___ playing in the garden.
items.explanation: Present Continuous для множественного числа — are.

items.sentence: I ___ never seen such a big dog.
items.explanation: Present Perfect с never: have + V3.

items.sentence: He ___ to the gym three times a week.
items.explanation: Present Simple 3-е лицо — goes.

items.sentence: We ___ our homework before dinner.
items.explanation: Past Simple регулярного глагола — finished.

items.sentence: She ___ a letter to her friend yesterday.
items.explanation: Past Simple неправильного глагола write — wrote.

items.sentence: They ___ been studying English for two years.
items.explanation: Present Perfect Continuous: have + been + V-ing.

items.sentence: The sun ___ in the east.
items.explanation: Факт общеизвестный — Present Simple, 3-е лицо — rises.

items.sentence: I ___ to call you later.
items.explanation: Будущее простое: will + инфинитив.

items.sentence: He ___ not finished his work yet.
items.explanation: Present Perfect отрицание: has not + V3.

items.sentence: We ___ never eat meat.
items.explanation: Present Simple отрицание для we — do not.

items.sentence: If she ___ here, she would help us.
items.explanation: Второго типа условное: if + were.
